source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 15 machine minutes; unique row/variant.

source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for an authoritative GPU/link graph, stable identities, versions, fabric-manager state and complete evidence.

old_problem: A GPU count or plausible topology matrix cannot prove the complete NVLink fabric: symmetric devices may be swapped, parallel links or generations may be missing, and insecure/truncated collection is unauditable. The expected identity-bound graph was absent.
disposition_reason: The row clearly requires NVLink enumeration and full topology via NVQual Test #9. The HGX model-specific GPU UUID/serial/slot map and expected node/edge/port/generation/state graph are authoritative Project Configuration. They can be supplied at runtime without a new review decision; absence closes the execution gate but does not make review semantics Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2135, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2136 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00013-V002 / 74c2bbcfce894726 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the licensed pinned Test #9/driver/firmware/fabric-manager stack and the signed GPU UUID/serial/slot expected fabric graph before collection.
Collect complete untruncated NVQual #9, nvidia-smi inventory, NVLink status and topology matrix through trusted authenticated access; reject sshpass and host-key bypass examples.

Normalize observed nodes and edges to stable identities, compare exact node/edge sets plus port, generation, link count/state and unexpected members, and retain the deterministic diff with raw artifacts.
Preserve/hash logs instead of clearing them. Do not reset links, restart fabric services or mutate topology to force agreement.
Stop on missing/degraded/unexpected links, identity ambiguity, fabric-manager or GPU loss, host instability, thermal/power fault or evidence gap; never retry automatically.
No NVQual/nvidia-smi, SSH, log clearing, link reset, fabric-manager restart, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Stable-identity full HGX NVLink fabric enumeration and topology
test_case.purpose: Enumerate every expected HGX GPU and NVLink edge with Test #9 and prove the complete observed identity-bound fabric graph and all per-link attributes exactly match the approved project model without hang, reboot or new fabric errors.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #9 with compatible driver/firmware/fabric-manager
Signed HGX GPU UUID/serial/slot identity map
Versioned expected full NVLink node/edge/port/generation/count/state graph and topology matrix
Approved normalization, disabled/unpopulated and error acceptance rules
Trusted authenticated access, complete artifact storage and fabric health collectors
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash baseline logs and fabric state. Through trusted authenticated access run the pinned NVQual Test #9 and collect complete local GPU inventory, `nvidia-smi nvlink -s`, `nvidia-smi topo -m`, fabric-manager health and error evidence without truncation. Normalize to stable UUID/serial/slot identities and emit an exact expected-versus-observed node/edge/attribute diff. Stop on first discrepancy; do not reset links, restart services or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved GPU node and NVLink edge is present exactly once with the expected endpoint identities, ports, generation, count and active state; no unexpected node/edge, fabric-manager/GPU fault, hang, reboot or disqualifying new error occurs, and all Test #9 items are accepted.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until the signed expected graph, identity map and versions are bound. PASS requires an exact accepted full-graph and attribute comparison plus complete health evidence. FAIL on missing, extra, misbound or degraded node/edge, wrong generation/count/state, fabric/GPU failure, hang/reboot or disqualifying error. Missing graph/tool/artifact is BLOCKED; count-only or visually plausible topology is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until Test #9 stack, stable identity map, expected graph and comparison rules are signed.
Use trusted authenticated access; never expose passwords or bypass host-key validation.
Preserve baseline logs and keep enumeration observational; no link reset or fabric mutation is authorized.
Stop without service restart, reset or automatic retry on first discrepancy.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #9 manifest/license/version and authorization
HGX GPU UUID/serial/slot inventory and signed expected full node/edge/link-attribute graph
Complete raw NVQual #9, NVLink status, topology matrix, fabric-manager health and timestamps
Driver/firmware/NVLink/PCIe/kernel/BMC/SEL health, baseline hashes, no-mutation/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: This is observational. On a graph discrepancy, fabric/GPU failure, instability or evidence gap, preserve the first raw artifacts and stop. Do not reset links or restart fabric-manager automatically; follow the signed owner recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not present.
